basic_info.description: Fabulous opportunity to own a one-bedroom flat with phenomenal Bay views in the historic Russian Hill district of San Francisco! The flat showcases a unique and coveted floor plan with a large bedroom that faces North with a panoramic view of the Bay and beyond, an open kitchen/dining area and deck/patio also graced with postcard worthy views.  The home is move-in ready, or the perfect open slate for the buyer who wants to add the finishing touches to make this their own special refuge inspired by their individual creativity and taste. The Fontana West offers a heated swimming pool and 24-hour doorman service adding security and convenience to your lifestyle in a location that is near North Beach, the Marina, Ghirardelli Square, Aquatic Park, Marina Green, world class dining, Pier 39, the Presidio, and more.
